finding: Authenticated workflow enumeration must retain the transmitted API version and response lifecycle metadata while excluding all credential-bearing and unrelated header values from durable evidence.

primary_sources: GitHub REST API response and pagination header behavior

behavior: Allowlist X-GitHub-Api-Version, Accept, User-Agent, response status, Deprecation, Sunset, Link, and X-GitHub-Request-Id.
Record only sensitive header names observed, never their values.
Reject evidence missing requested API version, transmitted API-version header, or valid response status.

verification.environment: isolated local Node runtime using exact committed source text

uncertainty: The builder is not yet wired into both authenticated enumeration clients.
No private-repository enumeration was executed in this slice.
No live GitHub response headers were retained or promoted.
falsification_route: Fail if any sensitive header value appears in serialized output.
Fail if missing API-version or status evidence is accepted.
Fail if the downstream response-version verifier cannot consume the sanitized shape.
Fail if Link pagination metadata is lost before pagination provenance validation.
next_action: Wire the sanitizer immediately after each authenticated HTTP response and before any retained-file write, then pass its output into verifyWorkflowEnumerationEvidence for both independent exact-commit enumeration clients.
